evidence: Manual application of check-probe-not-in-seed.py (private checker not run; this is a manual review, not a portal checker run). All 44 distinct created sentinels in tests/ (JUDGE-CS1, W0, L1, M1, M2, WL0, WL1, R0, R1, R1B, R2, R3, RX, X0, X1, H0, H1, H1C, H2, H3, E1, F1, F2, P1, P2, P3, U1, U2, U3, D1, D2, O, LA, LB, LE, LG, LR, LV, T0, T1, S0, S1, S2, G1) were extracted with grep -ohE 'JUDGE-[A-Z0-9]+' over tests/; grep -rni 'JUDGE' over environment/, solution/ and instruction.md returns zero hits. Every non-sentinel phrase the criteria tell the judge to type was also grepped case-insensitively against environment/assets, environment/instructions, instruction.md and solution/ (incl. public/index.html, app.js, server.js): 'Lease question', 'Wall check', 'See the M-12 terms', 'please review', 'survey update', 'Before wall', 'Too late', 'Root question', 'Level one/two/three', 'Unrelated', 'Delete parent', 'Reply stays', 'Delete me', 'Hold parent/child/grandchild', 'Not really On hold', 'Version one/two/stale', 'Hijack', 'bold part', 'code part', 'quoted line', 'alert(', 'example.org', 'onerror', 'javascript:', 'See draft', 'Temp', 'Gone soon', 'Unread one/two/gone', 'Sent once', 'Order A/B/C', 'Live base/gone/arrival/reply', 'Half typed', 'Transcript parent/child', 'Persist', 'Gate check' -> 0 hits each. Reference initial state = seed only: solution/app/server.js seedDatabase() (lines 93-127) inserts only seed accounts/matters/walls/messages/versions/reads, guarded by settings.seeded; solve.sh copies solution/app without an app.db. Seed copies are byte-identical and match raw-evidence-index hashes (f69616e2e3d42c3ab858192126cde96cc5a39786f7f21c450b25c4ed6559be36). Seeded-state transitions are not pre-satisfied either: 'Insurer letter acknowledged.' (seed_data.json lines 66-71) is hold:true so it is present before release (hold_scope_and_release step 6 observes a real disappearance); 'Probate estimate is 4,200 pounds.' with version '2,400' (lines 167-178) is present with an explicit positive control before timer_changes shortens; 'Boundary note' (K-10, exactly 7 days) is paired with the one-second-younger K-11 positive control. Search negatives use terms only in the right place: 'heads of terms' and 'Fenwick' occur only in M-12 (lines 139,146); 'notice recieved' only in K-2's version; 'original lease scan' only in K-1; 'rent review date' only in K-10. Within-run collisions checked: no sentinel is a substring of another that a search step uses (searches: JUDGE-W0, JUDGE-X0, JUDGE-X1, JUDGE-F1, JUDGE-D1, JUDGE-O, 'Persist child JUDGE-S1', 'Persist gone'); JUDGE-O occurs only in the three Order messages. Count/state checks that later criteria depend on (persistence step c, unread 'at least 2' for Gwen) are baseline-relative, and Gwen's '>=2' cannot be met by a global-read broken app because Dev's mark-unread leaves a shared count at 1. Plausible broken app tried: one that never stores posts but whose seed already holds a probe -> impossible, no probe is seeded; one that hardcodes seed and ignores timer/hold changes -> fails because Insurer letter and Probate are present initially with positive controls. Conforming alternative that could fail on this row's ground: none found; probes are unique to the judge. Out-of-scope observation for reconciliation (not this row's verdict): wall_mentions_and_links has the judge itself type 'See the M-12 terms JUDGE-L1' in M-11, so the matter number 'M-12' legitimately reaches Dev in Harriet's own text while the Fails clause says 'if Dev sees any part of the linked M-12 message or its matter'; a strict judge could misread that as a leak (criterion-clarity rows, e.g. 32).
